overview_description.description:
Altro helps you build your credit with everyday payments and subscriptions.

We help you earn credit by counting the recurring payments and subscriptions you’re already making. Our free Altro app allows you to easily link these recurring payments to leverage unseen and uncounted payments that build your credit score. 

Build credit and your financial power with the free Altro app and make every payment count.

product.name: Altro App
product.description: A mobile application that allows users to build their credit score by linking and reporting their subscription payments to credit bureaus.

product.name: Altro Credit Builder Credit Card
product.description: A credit card that does not require a credit check and is part of the Discover Global Network, designed to help users build credit through everyday payments.

product.name: Convos Podcast
product.description: A weekly podcast where users can ask experts questions about credit, community, and financial literacy.

product.name: Financial Literacy Resources
product.description: Educational content available through the Altro app to help users increase their financial literacy.
